title: Node analysis linear coefficient
statement: For each natural number $k$, let $F_k$ be the Fourier batch linear coefficient, $D_k$ the low degree junta cutoff, $W_k$ the polynomial work linear coefficient, and $P_k$ the low degree junta polynomial degree. The node analysis linear coefficient is $F_k(D_k+1)+W_k+(D_k+1)+(P_k+1)$.
